# METADATA
Name: Fifteen Miles
Website: https://www.fifteenmiles.tech
Tagline: Enterprise operating platforms built for decades.
Core_Business: Engineering and product organization focused on centralizing fragmented corporate operations into a single, highly configurable environment.

# ARCHITECTURAL_PHILOSOPHY
- Focus: Long-term infrastructure, architectural sovereignty, strict data governance.
- Concept: Software designed as "digital cathedrals" (built to last, scale, and resist digital decay).
- Goal: Elimination of fragmented legacy applications through Unified Operational Platforms.

# TECH_STACK
- Framework: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Typography: Fraunces, Inter, Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond
